{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-knit turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, cream (#EDE3D3), merino wool

High-waisted trousers, straight leg, full length to the top of the boot, dark chocolate (#4A3426), wool flannel

Textured blazer, single-breasted, slightly fitted, hip length, camel (#B58B5E), herringbone wool tweed

Overcoat, single-breasted, belted, knee length, deep navy (#26324A), dense wool-cashmere blend

Ankle boots, low block heel, grippy rubber sole, black (#1E1A17), waterproof-treated smooth leather that is easy to wipe clean of salt

Scarf, wide and generously long, burgundy (#6E2B3A), soft lambswool

Gloves, wrist length, dark brown (#3A2A20), leather with a warm lining

Knit beanie, close fitting, cream (#EDE3D3), wool-blend (optional for the walk, easy to take off at the door)

Structured tote bag, medium size, with a top handle and a zip, dark brown (#3A2A20), grained leather

Why this outfit works: layers of wool and a lined coat keep you warm through a 20-minute walk in frost and snow, and the blazer under the coat gives the office-ready, neat business look the moment you take the coat off. The waterproof leather boots with grippy soles handle snow and road salt, and the full-length trousers keep ankles covered and dry. The warm cream, camel and chocolate tones flatter your dark hair, brown eyes and warm skin, while the burgundy scarf adds a rich touch of color near the face.
